FACTUALITY: VERY LOW
GENRE: CONSPIRACY
BIAS: RIGHT

The homepage is saturated with overt conspiracy framing: a “Masonic Murder Ring” run by French intelligence, a “Quiet Coup” placing Israel inside U.S. intelligence, “The Epstein Class” fleeing to Albania, and a “Hidden Network” converging on Albania. It features commentary from right-wing figures such as Col. Doug Macgregor and consistently promotes anti-NATO, pro-Russia/China, and anti-“US Empire” narratives. No ordinary reporting is visible; every item is sensationalized and sourced to a recurring cast of alternative-media personalities rather than established newsgathering.

FACTUALITY: HIGH
GENRE: OTHER
BIAS: LEAST BIASED

The homepage presents a professional survey-research firm that highlights partnerships with credible institutions such as the Pew Research Center, Cornell University, and ABC News, and notes its charter membership in the American Association for Public Opinion Research’s Transparency Initiative. The visible text emphasizes methodological rigor, probability-based design, and full disclosure, with no overt partisan framing or advocacy in the mission or descriptions. The site operates as a genuine institutional presence rather than a news outlet, conspiracy operation, or imposter “pink slime” page.

FACTUALITY: LOW
GENRE: IMPOSTER
BIAS: LEAST BIASED

The site displays classic “pink slime” red flags: rigidly templated headlines (near-identical “Which former...” and “Who are the ex...” sports pieces), stories built around decontextualized data dumps (specific Medicaid dollar amounts and percentages presented without meaningful reporting), and generic bylines on formulaic hyperlocal content that mimics a newspaper without showing original editorial oversight. Despite a professional WordPress-style layout, the repetitive story structures and thin sourcing visible on the page indicate it is not a genuine local newsroom. None of the visible headlines carry overt partisan framing or editorial spin, so no political slant is detectable from the screenshot alone.
